clue.text: Southern Iceland?

parts.note: read not as the south of the Nordic island but as a land of ice at the far south of the globe

explanation.surface: A question about the southern part of the island nation of Iceland.
explanation.definitionFit: The polar continent around the South Pole is a frozen southern land, a true land of ice.

clue.text: Mother keeping the house in order

definitions.text: Mother keeping the house in order

parts.words: Mother keeping the house in order
parts.note: not a parent doing housework: a Mother Superior running a religious house of nuns, a member of a religious order

explanation.surface: A mum keeping the family home tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a convent is called Mother and governs a religious house of nuns.

clue.text: Now moving hospital into high official building

indicators.note: into says the shuffled word plus the hospital letter go inside the word for high

parts.note: high means tall

indicators.note: moving says the letters of the word now shift into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Relocating a hospital into a tall official building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' turns NOW into OWN; 'into' places OWN plus H inside TALL, between its T and ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A municipal headquarters where a council meets is the civic office block of a borough.

clue.text: Built up, or smashed down, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that a word is to be taken by its sound when spoken

parts.note: smashed down means razed, demolished to the ground

explanation.surface: A building either constructed or demolished, depending on how you hear it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something built up has been erected or lifted higher.

clue.text: Workers' representatives look at Italian

parts.note: a trade union, TU, represents workers
to scan is to look at closely

explanation.surface: Union officials examine an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: TU is the British abbreviation for trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Tuscany, the region around Florence, is an Italian of that region.

clue.text: He enjoys having people for dinner

definitions.text: He enjoys having people for dinner

parts.words: He enjoys having people for dinner
parts.note: sounds like a sociable host, but read literally the people are the meal

explanation.surface: A man who loves entertaining guests at dinner parties.
explanation.definitionFit: A man-eater consumes human flesh, so people are literally his dinner.

clue.text: March away to welcome her

parts.note: not soldiers marching off but the month of March departing, making way for the next month, also a woman's name

explanation.surface: Marching off to greet a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The month following March arrives when March has gone, and it is also a girl's name.

clue.text: Settles to have a quiet lot of drinks — nothing must interrupt

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical abbreviation for quiet

indicators.note: must interrupt says the letter for nothing breaks into the word for drinks

parts.note: pints are drinks of beer, a round of them
O, the zero shape, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to have a quiet few pints with no interruptions.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle a date or person is to fix or name them officially, a synonym sense.

clue.text: Run to get a plate for salad item

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
a plate is a dish

explanation.surface: Dashing off to get a plate for a salad.
explanation.definitionFit: A small red root vegetable eaten raw is a common salad ingredient.

clue.text: Concerned with future, be keen to have period of schooling

parts.note: to long for something is to be keen on it
a school year is split into terms

explanation.surface: A forward-looking person eager for a school term.
explanation.definitionFit: Planning for years ahead rather than the present is planning for a distant time.

clue.text: Complains, rejecting network, and does poorly

indicators.note: rejecting means the word for network is turned back to front

parts.note: a web is a network
someone who ails is in poor health

explanation.surface: A grumbler who rejects the internet and fares badly.
explanation.definitionFit: To lament or grieve aloud over something is a strong way of grumbling about it.

clue.text: Having a vet remove something

parts.note: suggests an animal doctor's operation, but to vet is to check material and cut out objectionable parts

explanation.surface: Taking a pet to have something removed by a veterinary surgeon.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting offensive material after inspection is the work of an official who suppresses content.

clue.text: Deputy makes mark around north Dakota

indicators.note: around says the word for mark wraps the two abbreviations

parts.note: a stain is a mark
D is the initial of Dakota

explanation.surface: A deputy leaves a mark on North Dakota.
explanation.definitionFit: A substitute who takes another's place temporarily acts as their deputy.

clue.text: Spirit has been distilled

indicators.note: distilled hints at alcohol but signals the letters of the phrase are processed into a new form

explanation.surface: A spirit, as in a liquor, that has gone through the still.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distilled' rearranges the letters of HAS BEEN; 'Spirit' is a ghost, not a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: In Irish folklore a wailing female ghost foretells a death.

clue.text: Freedom for views here in Westminster madhouse?

definitions.meaning: refuge granted to a person persecuted for their opinions in their home country
Westminster is the seat of the British Parliament, so a madhouse there is a parliamentary lunatic asylum

explanation.surface: A comment on the chaos of British parliamentary politics.
explanation.walkthrough: Westminster is the London district where the UK Parliament sits.
explanation.definitionFit: Protection given by a state to a refugee fleeing persecution for beliefs, and jokingly a parliament seen as a lunatic house.

clue.text: Mournful chap supporting proposal

indicators.note: in a down clue the word below supports the word above it

parts.note: a plan is a proposal
a gent is a chap

explanation.surface: A sad man backing a scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A plangent sound is loud and plaintive, resonating with sorrow.

clue.text: Not the first person to patrol the boundary?

definitions.text: Not the first person to patrol the boundary?

parts.words: Not the first person to patrol the boundary?
parts.note: in grammar, not first person but a later one; in cricket, a fielder stationed near the boundary behind the wicket

explanation.surface: Wondering who was not the first guard to walk the border.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a fielding position deep behind the batsman on the off side, often near the boundary rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket fielding position out near the rope, and literally someone coming after the first and second persons.

clue.text: Take a chance and throw out heaps

parts.note: to cast is to throw
lots means heaps, a great amount

explanation.surface: Gambling and throwing away piles of things.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing straws or dice to decide something leaves the outcome to fortune, a gamble.

clue.text: In speech, swearwords could be bad

definitions.text: In speech, swearwords could be bad

parts.words: In speech, swearwords could be bad
parts.note: the word means speech in general, and also, as in 'mind your ...', bad words or swearing

explanation.surface: Advice that cursing out loud is a poor idea.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means human speech and, in British usage, foul words, so bad speech is swearing.

clue.text: Asks for fruit one can bite into

indicators.note: can bite into says the numeral for one sits inside the word for fruit, as a bite goes into it

parts.note: apples are fruit
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Requesting fruit that a person can eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who puts in a request or application for something is formally requesting it.

clue.text: Competitor parking on course

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another comes above it

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
a course of bricks is a layer

explanation.surface: A rival parking on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A participant in a game or sport is a contestant.

clue.text: Ancestor of ours had house, car, and daughter

parts.note: the Mini is a classic small British car
D is the abbreviation for daughter in genealogy

explanation.surface: A forebear who owned a house, a car and had a daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the family of great apes including early humans is a forebear of humankind.

clue.text: Sweet buzzing insect

parts.note: to hum is to buzz
a bug is an insect

explanation.surface: A sweet bee buzzing about.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a humbug is a striped boiled mint sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard striped mint is a traditional British boiled confection.

clue.text: Thinking America may be squeezed by china

indicators.note: may be squeezed by says the word for America is pressed inside the word for china

parts.note: Ming is a dynasty famous for its porcelain

explanation.surface: America under pressure from China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'china' is porcelain, not the country, despite the capital letter missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Pondering or reflecting is a form of deep thought.

clue.text: Humiliate disciplinary officer that arrests me

indicators.note: arrests means holds in, so the officer's title captures the word me

parts.note: at a university a dean is responsible for discipline
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dean of discipline who detains the speaker humiliates them.
explanation.definitionFit: To degrade or lower someone's dignity is to humble or shame them.

clue.text: Tricky feat results in huge smash

parts.note: grand means huge
to slam is to smash

explanation.surface: A difficult achievement ends in an enormous crash.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge it means winning all thirteen tricks, so a 'tricky' feat; in tennis, winning all four major titles.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking every trick in a hand of bridge is the supreme achievement in the game.

clue.text: Fighting force ordered to hide equipment

indicators.note: to hide says the word for equipment is concealed inside the word for ordered

parts.note: bade means ordered, past tense of bid
rig is equipment, gear

explanation.surface: An army unit told to conceal its kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A military unit made up of several battalions is an armed formation.

clue.text: Venturing in part of foreign city

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters inside the word Venturing

explanation.surface: Travelling into part of a city abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Piedmont in northern Italy is a city abroad from a British view.

clue.text: Wise man leading naive in something shady

indicators.note: leading puts the word for wise man in front of the word for naive

parts.note: a sage is a wise man
green means inexperienced, naive

explanation.surface: A wise man guiding an innocent into something dubious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shady' suggests dishonest but means a shade, a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A muted grey-green tint is a shade of colour.
